cases.title: Rebuild a marketing page
cases.question: Implement a responsive marketing page from the supplied desktop and mobile reference images using the repository's existing framework and assets. Match hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, and image crops without embedding the reference image.
cases.intent: Measure visual reconstruction and repository-aware frontend implementation.
acceptance: Desktop and mobile layouts match their references
No horizontal overflow at 360px
Semantic headings and landmarks are present
Existing build and lint commands pass

cases.title: Reconstruct a data dashboard
cases.question: Recreate the supplied analytics dashboard as maintainable components. Preserve the navigation shell, KPI cards, chart region, table density, and responsive stacking behavior while reusing the project's design tokens.
cases.intent: Measure structural decomposition and fidelity on a dense application surface.
acceptance: Reusable components replace duplicated markup
Table remains readable at tablet width
Loading and empty states are implemented
Visual regression screenshots pass

cases.title: Build tabs and a modal
cases.question: Implement a settings card with three tabs and an edit modal. Tab state must be reflected in the URL, modal changes must support save and cancel, and focus must return to the trigger after closing.
cases.intent: Measure coordinated component state, navigation state, and focus behavior.
acceptance: Back and forward navigation restore the selected tab
Escape and backdrop close the modal
Focus is trapped while the modal is open
Interaction tests cover save and cancel

cases.title: Repair an asynchronous form
cases.question: Fix the account form so client validation, server validation, submission progress, success feedback, and retryable errors behave consistently. Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve user input after a failed request.
cases.intent: Measure robust form state and failure recovery rather than happy-path rendering.
acceptance: Invalid fields expose associated error messages
Only one request can be active
Server errors preserve entered values
Success and retry flows have automated tests

cases.title: Implement an accessible combobox
cases.question: Implement an asynchronous people-search combobox with debounced results, keyboard navigation, highlighted matches, selection chips, and an empty state. Follow the ARIA combobox interaction pattern.
cases.intent: Measure accessibility semantics together with nontrivial interaction state.
acceptance: Arrow keys, Enter, Escape, and Tab behave correctly
ARIA expanded, controls, and active-descendant states are valid
Stale network responses cannot replace newer results
Screen-reader labels are meaningful

cases.title: Complete a stateful data grid
cases.question: Complete the issue table so search, status filters, sortable columns, pagination, row selection, and bulk actions compose correctly. Persist shareable view state in the query string.
cases.intent: Measure interacting state machines and deterministic derived data.
acceptance: Filtering resets invalid page positions
Sort order is stable and announced accessibly
Bulk actions affect only selected visible records
URL state round-trips after reload

cases.title: Fix a responsive regression
cases.question: Use the attached before-and-expected screenshots to diagnose and fix the responsive regression in the existing navigation. Keep desktop behavior unchanged while correcting the clipped mobile menu and misplaced overlay.
cases.intent: Measure visual evidence interpretation and a minimal repository patch.
acceptance: The mobile menu is fully reachable at 320px and 390px
Overlay covers only the intended viewport
Desktop snapshots remain unchanged
A regression test fails before and passes after the fix

cases.title: Repair dark-mode contrast
cases.question: Diagnose the dark-mode differences shown in the issue screenshot and repair the token or component styles causing unreadable text, invisible borders, and incorrect chart labels without hard-coding per-component colors.
cases.intent: Measure screenshot-guided debugging across shared design tokens.
acceptance: Affected text meets WCAG AA contrast
Shared tokens fix every affected component
Light mode has no visual regression
Theme tests cover both color schemes

cases.title: Eliminate stale search results
cases.question: Fix the existing live-search race where a slow earlier request can overwrite a newer result set. Preserve caching and loading indicators, cancel work when possible, and avoid state updates after unmount.
cases.intent: Measure causal debugging and a narrow regression-safe patch in an existing codebase.
acceptance: Only the latest query may update visible results
Unmount produces no state update warning
Caching behavior is preserved
A deterministic race-condition test is added

cases.title: Fix optimistic update rollback
cases.question: Repair the optimistic favorite toggle so rapid clicks, server rejection, and refetching cannot leave the count and selected state inconsistent. Make the smallest change compatible with the repository's data-fetching conventions.
cases.intent: Measure repository navigation, concurrency reasoning, and regression testing.
acceptance: Rapid toggles settle on the final user intent
Rejected mutations roll back state and count
Successful mutations reconcile with server data
Existing unrelated cache behavior remains unchanged
